BGToll mobile application offers road users a quick and easy access to the most important features of the Bulgarian electronic toll collection system - right from the mobile device, at any time and any place.  BGToll facilitates the purchase of e-Vignettes for light vehicles and trailers as well as Route Passes for trucks and buses. 

e-Vignettes are available for certain validity periods which are: 
•	Week
•	Weekend
•	Month
•	Quarter
•	Year
Route Passes are valid for a certain route for a specific day. You can simply select the departure and destination of your journey together with the vehicle classification and BGToll calculates the associated price of the given route.   

The payment can be done with a variety of different debit, credit and fleet cards. 
The receipt will be sent via Email and can also be downloaded as PDF file. 

In case you are a registered user, BGToll facilitates the management of your account and vehicles as well as already purchased Route Passes. Road users with a pre-pay account can also top-up the account balance.
